summary:
Plan written to plan.md. The tower stacks eight identical segments, each a notched square that flares out one block every 6 courses, from 62 wide at its foot to a 76-wide lit ledge, so each one overhangs the next like a pagoda.
It sits on a stepped pedestal (76 tapering to 62) with gold coin medallions on all four faces. The crown is a lit observatory, three flared pinnacle tiers, a stepped cap and a slim spire with red aircraft lights.
Cyan glass on a gray mullion grid with dark floor lines, gold corner light strips and ruyi ornaments make it read as Taipei 101 at dusk; the six-storey mall steps down in terraces from y 68 to y 35. `chain` is left out because the toolkit's block check doesn't recognise it. Taipei 101 as three tiling modules: a 76-sq tapering pedestal with 4 gold coins plus the stepped podium mall; ONE 8-floor flared segment (notched corners, ruyi, gold light strips, lit ledge band) that stacks eight times; and the observatory, three-tier pinnacle and spire with red aircraft lights.
All three share the 62-sq foot and 76-sq top, with mullions on one absolute grid, so they line up. Dusk comes from froglight lit windows, sea-lantern bands and shroomlight uplights.

Podium mall piers, spandrels, plinths, coping and parapets in pale stone
Ruyi cloud-scroll ornaments, gold coin medallions, spire mast and lightning rod
Dusk lighting: froglight offices, sea-lantern bands, uplights, red aircraft lights, no dark roof
Mall sign TAIPEI 101 MALL in lit block letters, reading left to right
